    assert slugify('Keep Drop Tail', stopwords=['Drop'], lowercase=False) == 'Keep-Tail'
    assert slugify('Hello World', max_length=5) == 'hello'
    assert slugify('Hello World', max_length=5, word_boundary=True) == 'hello'
    assert slugify('a b', separator='_') == 'a_b'
